name: PPT Live
description: AI deck studio for PPT generation and editing: describe your deck in the floating session bubble, watch designed slides land on the canvas, refine page content, preview, and export editable PPTX or shareable HTML.
permission_rationale: PPT Live stores only its own deck draft, runs hidden OpenBitFun agent turns (ppt-design skill plus research tools such as WebSearch/WebFetch) only when the user asks it to generate or refine content, uses the model selected in the host's shared floating chat, and exports PPTX/PDF/PNG/HTML entirely inside the desktop WebView.

ai_context.original_prompt: A built-in Live App for AI-assisted PPT generation, preview, and visual editing.

zh-CN.name: PPT 工作台
zh-CN.description: AI PPT 工作台：在右下角悬浮会话气泡中描述需求，设计页面实时上屏；支持局部优化、演示预览，并导出可编辑 PPTX 或 HTML 演示稿。
